_comment: Single source of truth for LLM default settings, shared by AHK and Hammerspoon drivers.
_comment2: When adding a new setting: add it here first, then consume it in both drivers.
_comment_test_prediction: Temperature of the AI menu's « Test a prediction » alone, never a setting: a fixed sample at the low generation temperature repeats one answer, and a repeated answer proves nothing. 1.0 is the top of every provider's accepted range; the models of thinking_off.json that accept only the default sampling still receive none.
_comment_owned_port: Port of the Ollama daemon Ergopti installs and pins itself, never 11434: a user's own Ollama keeps that port and is never contacted, stopped or modified.
_comment_platform: Per-platform model/backend defaults are intentionally NOT in this shared file: the available models and default backend differ by platform, so each driver owns them (windows/lib/llm_defaults.ahk, macos/modules/llm/init.lua).
